name: Personal agent current work and next actions
summary: Complete attention uses one work snapshot. Over-bound single-agent reads page until claimable suggestions fill or the 1,000-row bound, then recover own work with up to 1,000 owner-filtered rows. Owner lists reuse bounded rows. Three independent truncation flags distinguish snapshot, own counts and actions; incomplete counts say at least N and cannot imply idle. Failed authorized work reads say error; successful-project actions survive. Absent legacy blocking_items uses open_items; explicit unreadable fields stay unknown. Latest blockers/dependencies block undelivered work; delivery review takes precedence. Request IDs cap at20 only as defensive injected-row projection, not a reachable sequence of real review writes. Current-assignee comments stay quiet, other authors wake; unattributed native edits may stay quiet. Review recommendations/order and live authority are retained. This proposal remains unaccepted; integration and verification are separate.
